title: German Family Court Reportedly Had to Check False Citations in a Filing with Apparently AI-Generated Legal Claims
summary: A family court in Cologne, Germany, reportedly had to check a lawyer's citations in a parenting-time case and found that several were invented or misattributed. The judge said some of the legal claims appeared to have been generated with AI and directed the lawyer to stop making such submissions.
